sources.title: GitHub - Sumandora/remove-refusals-with-transformers: Implements ...
sources.snippet: This is a crude, proof-of-concept implementation to remove refusals from an LLM model without using TransformerLens. This means, that this supports every model that HF Transformers supports*. The code was tested on a RTX 2060 6GB, thus mostly <3B models have been tested, but the code has been tested to work with bigger models as well. *While most models are compatible, some models are not ...
